actions.text: Pressing Search with rows selected runs an episode search command for the selected episode ids, then refetches the list.
Pressing Search with nothing selected opens a confirmation modal "Search for all missing episodes" showing the total record count and a mass search cancel warning.
Confirming the modal runs a missing-episode search command built from the active filters, refetches the list and closes the modal.
Monitor/Unmonitor Selected toggles the monitored state of the selected episodes through a PUT to the episode monitor endpoint.
Manual Import opens the interactive import modal.
The list is loaded from the wanted/missing endpoint with page, page size, sort and filters.
Users can pick a filter, sort by a column, change table options (columns, page size) and select all or individual rows. Changing page size returns to page 1.

rules.text: The Search button is disabled and spinning while a missing-episode or episode search command is queued or started.
Monitor/Unmonitor Selected is disabled when nothing is selected. It reads "Unmonitor Selected" when the selected filter shows monitored episodes, and sets monitored to the opposite of that.
The same command is not sent again if it was run within the last 5 seconds.
Only filters seriesIds, qualityProfileIds, seriesType, seriesTags and quality are passed into the search-all command body.
The page number starts at 1 and resets to 1 on back/forward navigation. Total pages is at least 1 when records are loaded.
Filters come from the selected built-in filter or the saved custom filter of type wanted.missing; the previous page data is kept while a new page loads.

shows.text: The page is titled "Missing" with the heading scope "Wanted".
Missing episodes are listed in a paged table, with a row per episode. Rows for episodes whose series is not found are not shown.
Each row has a select checkbox and the visible columns: series title link, episode number, episode title link, air date, last search time, status and a search/actions cell.
A loading indicator shows while the list is fetching and loading.
When loading fails and it is not fetching, an error alert shows the message for "MissingLoadError".
When there is no error and no records, a "MissingNoItems" message is shown instead of the table.
A pager below the table shows the current page, total pages and total records.
The toolbar has Search (label "Search Selected" when any row is selected, otherwise "Search All"), Monitor/Unmonitor Selected, Manual Import, Options and a filter menu.

sideEffects.text: The page refetches the list when seriesUpdated, episodeFileUpdated or episodeFileDeleted updates occur.
After a successful monitor toggle, the cached episodes are updated with the new monitored value.
Running a search posts a command to the command API.
The query key of the loaded missing list is stored for the wanted.missing episode entity.
